base_url.correction: No single global base URL. Workspace APIs use https://gateway.dgxc-lepton.nvidia.com/api/v2/workspaces/<WORKSPACE_ID>, while inference uses the deployed endpoint's own URL.

auth_type.correction: Bearer token (user or workspace token) in the Authorization header; individual inference endpoints may instead be public or protected by endpoint tokens/IP allowlists.

example.correction: Use the deployed endpoint URL and its documented route, for example: curl -X POST "<ENDPOINT_URL>/v1/chat/completions" -H "content-type: application/json" -H "accept: application/json" -d '<request JSON>'. Add Authorization: Bearer <token> when token protection is enabled.

description.correction: NVIDIA DGX Cloud Lepton is a fully managed platform for developing, training, and deploying AI models. It provides hosted endpoints, REST API support, and a Python SDK for workspace operations.

notes: Lepton AI is now NVIDIA DGX Cloud Lepton. The legacy website redirects to NVIDIA, and the submitted docs URL is obsolete. Current access is workspace- and endpoint-specific; no official current evidence was found for a free tier, its limits, request-rate limits, or CORS behavior.
